title: Bamboo, the giant grass
text:
Bamboo looks like a tree, but it is really a kind of grass. There are more than a thousand kinds of bamboo, and many of them grow in Indonesia.

Fast growers
Bamboo is one of the fastest growing plants on Earth. Some kinds can grow almost a metre in a single day! A bamboo stem is called a culm. It is hollow inside, with rings called nodes along it.

Bamboo in Indonesia
People in Indonesia have used bamboo for hundreds of years. Some houses have bamboo walls and floors. Bamboo is made into baskets, mats, bridges and even bicycles. In West Java, people play the angklung, a musical instrument made of bamboo tubes. When you shake it, it plays a soft, rattling note.

Good for the planet
When bamboo is cut, new stems grow back from the roots, so people can use it again and again. The roots also hold the soil together. This helps to stop soil from sliding down hills in heavy rain.

Did you know?
Giant pandas in China spend about half of each day eating bamboo!
